short: Class balancing; test whether it is needed
why: Classes are already nearly even, so synthetic images may add nothing
decision: Primary task: class balancing. Success: recommend synthetic only if macro-F1 of real+synthetic beats best of real_only/class-weighted/oversample with paired bootstrap CI excluding 0; else recommend the simple baseline. Run one cheap conditional DDPM to give generation a fair test.
evidence: profile.json: imbalance_ratio_max_over_min=1.64 (<3), normalized_entropy=0.9949, smallest class normal colon mucosa n_train=7886
alternatives_rejected: decline outright without any evidence: rejected, cheap test can show baselines

why: Standard input range for image diffusion with a convolutional network
decision: --prep scale_pm1, no subsampling of rare classes

why: Enough images per class; diffusion gives sharpest samples
Fits the 15-minute budget; leaves time for sampling and testing
decision: ddpm conv ch=32, T=1000 cosine, p_uncond 0.1, ema 0.999, bs128, lr2e-4, max-minutes 12, full train split (smoke test passed)

why: Loss fell steadily; time limit stopped it after 12 passes
decision: ddpm_conv_ch32: stopped by 12 min limit at epoch 12 (~8.4k steps, below the 10k target); eps_mse falls from 0.24 (t5%) to 0.001 (t95%) as expected
alternatives_rejected: retrain longer: budget exhausted (12 of 15 min used)

short: Add 4,000 images to each of 3 smallest classes
why: Lifts the rarest classes toward the largest; keeps sampling time modest
decision: class-counts: normal colon mucosa 4000, mucus 4000, adipose 4000; DDIM 50 steps, guidance 2.0, tag balance
alternatives_rejected: full balance to 12885 (~26k images): too slow

short: Compare against simple baselines on a classifier
why: Synthetic data must beat class weights and oversampling to be worth using
decision: fidelity, memorization, utility augment on samples_balance. Synthetic images are visibly unrealistic (grid), recognised as intended class only 55% (real 60%), C2ST 0.957 vs 0.900 ref, precision 0.33 vs 0.73. Adding them collapses macro-F1 to 0.211 vs real_only 0.619, class-weighted 0.472, oversample 0.584; all CIs of difference below 0. No copying (frac_nearest_train 0.468, 0 exact copies).
alternatives_rejected: skip fidelity: rejected, skill says always run

why: They hurt the classifier; classes are already nearly balanced
decision: Do not use (use real data as is; real_only was best baseline). No iteration run: 12 of 15 budget minutes used, and imbalance 1.64 means little to fix; a longer-trained model would have to overcome a -0.40 macro-F1 gap.
alternatives_rejected: retrain/iterate: unaffordable and unlikely to change verdict
